name: Gao tim than
summary: Gạo tím than is purple rice from Lò gạch cũ Farmstay in thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh, listed at 3 stars. The 2023 fair calls it gạo tím than lò gạch cũ.
origin: Thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh.
where: Lò gạch cũ Farmstay, thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh.
The fair of 22–24 Sep 2023 calls it gạo tím than lò gạch cũ.
